name: MathlibAnnex.CStarAlgebra.CAR.homogeneityShellFamily
title: Choosing the CAR shell family from proved homogeneity

content.display_title: Choosing the CAR shell family from proved homogeneity
content.one_sentence_role: CAR homogeneity and exact shell matching supply one family whose distinguished component is fixed by an explicit identity choice.
content.natural_language_statement: Let $A$ be the completed CAR algebra, the norm completion of the matrix stages $A_n=M_{2^n}(\mathbb C)$ under $a\mapsto a\otimes I_2$, with the fixed coordinate reindexing. Write $\iota_n:A_n\to A$ for the canonical inclusion, $\omega(\iota_n(a))=a_{00}$ for the root state, $f_n=\iota_n(E_{00})$ for its decreasing root projections, and $p_n=f_n-f_{n+1}$ for the difference shells. Each $p_n$ is a self-adjoint projection. Let $I$ be the set of unitary-equivalence classes of pure-state Gelfand–Naimark–Segal (GNS) representations of $A$. Choose a representative pure state $\varphi_j$ for each $j\in I$, with the distinguished class $o=[\omega]$ represented by $\varphi_o=\omega$. Fix the following representative shell family. At $o$, choose $\alpha_o=\mathrm{id}_A$ and $w_{o,n}=p_n$. At every other $j$, choose an automorphism $\alpha_j$ from CAR homogeneity for the pair $(\varphi_j,\omega)$, and then choose shell links for that same automorphism. Thus $\varphi_j(\alpha_j(a))=\omega(a)$, $w_{j,n}^*w_{j,n}=\alpha_j(p_n)$, and $w_{j,n}w_{j,n}^*=p_n$. This fixed choice is the homogeneity shell family.
content.definition_explanation: The component supplier branches on $j=o$. On the root branch, the root-state representative is exactly $\omega$ and $p_n^*p_n=p_n=p_np_n^*$, so identity and the shells themselves satisfy all component equations. On a non-root branch, homogeneity gives one $\alpha_j$ with $\varphi_j\circ\alpha_j=\omega$ and approximate innerness. Apply the arbitrary-family shell-matching theorem to this $\alpha_j$ and $(p_n)_n$, and choose its link sequence. The two root lemmas certify the explicit branch, and the displayed definition assembles these data into one family.
content.assumptions: The selected states are pure, including the root state. CAR homogeneity is a proved result, and the difference shells are projections. No external KOS proposition or pre-existing shell family is an input to this definition.
content.conclusion: The definition supplies a value of the representative-family structure, including both root equations. The same selected value can be carried into later constructions without making a fresh choice at each use.
content.lean_realization_notes: This is a fixed choice, not a uniqueness theorem for all possible families. In particular, the non-root links need not be unique. The subsequent structural theorem uses this very family. The present definition does not itself prove uniqueness of the irreducible representation class, the rank-one identities, simplicity, or the exclusion of compact-operator algebras.
